notes: A main menu after the load finishes. The loading bar completes, the panel does not appear on its own any more: a card takes its place with the wordmark, the build and rev, and Enter / Settings / Credits. Enter fades the hub in. Settings is a shortcut into the real Settings tab, not a second copy, so the tab list is unchanged once you are in. Credits resolves 1562524075 when the menu is built - display name and user name from the Players API, with the in-game player and a name lookup as fallbacks if the batch call is unavailable - so the card never shows a stale hardcoded name. The menu holds the window back rather than racing the reveal: it waits for loadingDone, hides the window and shadow, and restores both exactly where the reveal left them.
